I implemented `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` in `minidb/parser.py`. All 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I didn't run the integration tests or the rest of the suite.

I didn't need to change `tests/test_parser.py`, because those tests build their tokens by hand and don't depend on the tokenizer.

The parser is a private `_Parser` class plus the three public functions, and I added no new public names.
